content.short: Helius provides Solana development optimization via RPCs, APIs, and webhooks.
content.description: Helius simplifies building on Solana by delivering developer APIs for transactions and NFTs, along with webhooks and high-performance RPCs. With these tools, you can create services that emit notifications or trigger events when notable activity happens on Solana, such as a known collector purchasing a new NFT. By removing much of the onboarding and infrastructure work, Helius enables applications to monitor on-chain activity, respond in real time, and scale as demand grows.
